Privacy and cookies

Last updated: 4 November 2026

Weather Pulse (weatherpulse.eu) is a free site for weather forecasts, magnetic storms and holidays. We have no registration, forms or server of our own holding data: the site is static and hosted on GitHub Pages. Here we explain what happens to your data while you use it.

Settings that stay in your browser

To remember your choices, the site saves the following in the browser's local storage (localStorage):

  • the chosen language and background;
  • the last searched place, recent places and favourite places;
  • your choice about cookies;
  • whether notifications about magnetic storms are switched on.

This data does not leave your device and is not sent to us. You can delete it at any time by clearing the site data in your browser settings.

Google Analytics (only with consent)

If you press "Accept" in the cookie banner, we load Google Analytics to see summary statistics: how many visits there are, which pages are opened and from which devices. Google Analytics stores cookies and processes your IP address; the provider is Google, which may process the data outside the EU. If you press "Decline" or choose nothing, Google Analytics is not loaded and no such cookies are stored.

You can change your choice at any time with the 🍪 button in the bottom corner of the page. If you decline, we delete the Google Analytics cookies.

External services for the data

The forecast and other data are loaded directly by your browser from the following services. They receive your IP address and, when you look up a forecast, the coordinates of the place:

  • Open-Meteo — the weather forecast and place search;
  • NOAA SWPC — magnetic storms and the solar wind;
  • Nager.Date — public holidays;
  • OpenStreetMap Nominatim — the name of a place from its coordinates;
  • Windy — the map on the Weather Maps page;
  • Google Fonts — the fonts of the site;
  • GitHub Pages — hosting of the site (keeps technical logs with IP addresses for security).

Location

The current location button works only if you allow it in the browser. The coordinates are used only to load the forecast for your place and are not stored on a server.

Magnetic storm notifications

If you switch notifications on, your browser itself checks the NOAA forecast and shows a notification when a storm is expected. We do not use a notification server and do not collect data about your device. You can switch them off on the Magnetic Storms page or in the browser settings.

Your rights

Because we do not store personal data on a server of our own, most of your data is only on your device. For questions or requests about the data processed through Google Analytics, write to us at woodwideweb@yahoo.com. You have the right to lodge a complaint with the Commission for Personal Data Protection (Bulgaria).
